You are being evaluated on Continual-ARC, a lifelong stream of ARC-style grid puzzles.
Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the
stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object
on the last line of your reply:
  {"action": "submit", "grid": [[0, 1, 2], [3, 4, 5]]}   submit an output grid
  {"action": "request_demos"}                            ask for one more demonstration pair for this task
  {"action": "finish"}                                   end the instance, once it is over
Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

Scoring: an instance you solve costs 1 for each wrong submission and 1 for
each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

import json, os, re
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
def solve_bbox(inp):
    H=len(inp); W=len(inp[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in inp for x in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    cells=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if inp[r][c]!=bg]
    r0=min(r for r,c in cells); c0=min(c for r,c in cells)
    ph=max(r for r,c in cells)-r0+1; pw=max(c for r,c in cells)-c0+1
    P=[[inp[r0+a][c0+c] for c in range(pw)] for a in range(ph)]
    out=[[P[(i-r0)%ph][(j-c0)%pw] for j in range(W)] for i in range(H)]
    return out
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4']:
    o=G[k+' output']; g=solve_bbox(G[k+' input']); print(k, g==o)
print(json.dumps(solve_bbox(G['Test input'])))

def solve(inp):
    H=len(inp); W=len(inp[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in inp for x in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    sepR={i for i in range(H) if len(set(inp[i]))==1}
    sepC={j for j in range(W) if len({inp[i][j] for i in range(H)})==1}
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if inp[r][c]!=bg and r not in sepR and c not in sepC]
    rs=[p[0] for p in pts]; cs=[p[1] for p in pts]
    r0=min(rs); r1=max(rs); c0=min(cs); c1=max(cs)
    pat=[[inp[r][c] for c in range(c0,c1+1)] for r in range(r0,r1+1)]
    out=[row[:] for row in inp]
    # fill every block (including the pattern block, redundant) with pattern aligned at block origin
    for r in range(H):
        if r in sepR: continue
        bi=sum(1 for s in sepR if s<=r)-1  # block index
        ra = max((s for s in sepR if s<r), default=-1)+1
        ca = max((s for s in sepC if s<j), default=-1)+1 if False else None
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if i in sepR or j in sepC: continue
            ra = max((s for s in sepR if s<i), default=-1)+1
            ca = max((s for s in sepC if s<j), default=-1)+1
            out[i][j]=pat[i-ra][j-ca]
    return out

import os,re,json
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
print(sorted(G))
# Check demo1 tile: pattern block is bottom-left? bbox of non-bg cells outside sep lines? Sep cols: col6 (color 6). sep row 4,9. Pattern occupies rows10-13 cols0-5... but there are other colored cells at row10 col5=2? no that's 2 = different color. So pattern = cells {2,8,5,0,9,4,3} in rows10-13,cols0-5. In output tile replicated across whole grid with same phase anchored at its own position (i.e., out[i][j] = pat[(i-r0)%ph][(j-c0)%pw]). Let's verify that exact global-phase tiling on all demos.
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4','Demo pair 5']:
    i=G[k+' input']
    H=len(i); W=len(i[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in i for x in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    sepR={r for r in range(H) if len(set(i[r]))==1}
    sepC={c for c in range(W) if len({i[r][c] for r in range(H)})==1}
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if i[r][c]!=bg and r not in sepR and c not in sepC]
    rs=[p[0] for p in pts]; cs=[p[1] for p in pts]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    pat=[[i[r][c] for c in range(c0,c1+1)] for r in range(r0,r1+1)]
    ph,pw=r1-r0+1,c1-c0+1
    o=G[k+' output']
    pred=[[pat[(r-r0)%ph][(c-c0)%pw] for c in range(W)] for r in range(H)]
    print(k, pred==o)

def f(inp):
    h,w=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    def lines(vals):
        L=[]
        for v in set(vals):
            if v!=0 and all(x==v for x in vals): L.append(v)
        return L
    sepR=[r for r in range(h) if len(set(inp[r]))==1 and inp[r][0]!=0]
    sepC=[c for c in range(w) if len({inp[r][c] for r in range(h)})==1 and inp[0][c]!=0]
    cells=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if inp[r][c]!=0 and r not in sepR and c not in sepC]
    rs=[r for r,c in cells]; cs=[c for r,c in cells]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    pat=[[inp[r][c] for c in range(c0,c1+1)] for r in range(r0,r1+1)]
    pr=r1-r0+1; pc=c1-c0+1
    # periods: use sep spacing if available else bbox size
    pR = min(sepR[1:]-sepR[:-1]) if len(sepR)>1 else pr
    pC = min(sepC[1:]-sepC[:-1]) if len(sepC)>1 else pc
    svals={inp[r][0] for r in sepR}
    scol={inp[0][c] for c in sepC}
    sepcolor=list(scols or svals)[0] if (scols or svals) else None
    O=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if i in sepR or j in sepC: O[i][j]=sepcolor
            else: O[i][j]=pat[(i-r0)%pr][(j-c0)%pc]
    return O

import json
gi,go=G['Demo pair 5 input'],G['Demo pair 5 output']
t=G['Test input']

def f(inp):
    h,w=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    sepR={r for r in range(h) if len(set(inp[r]))==1 and inp[r][0]!=0}
    sepC={c for c in range(w) if len({inp[r][c] for r in range(h)})==1 and inp[0][c]!=0}
    # pattern bbox: non-sep nonzero cells
    cells=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if inp[r][c]!=0 and r not in sepR and c not in sepC]
    rs=[r for r,c in cells]; cs=[c for r,c in cells]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    pat=[[inp[r][c] for c in range(c0,c1+1)] for r in range(r0,r1+1)]
    pv=r1-r0+1; pc=c1-c0+1
    scolor=inp[min(sepR)][0] if sepR else inp[0][min(sepC)]
    O=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if i in sepR or j in sepC:
                O[i][j]=scolor
            else:
                ri=(i-r0)%(pv+1); cj=(j-c0)%(pc+1)
                O[i][j]=pat[ri][cj] if ri<pv and cj<pc else scolor
    return O

print("demo match:", f(gi)==go)
res=f(t)
for r in res: print(''.join(map(str,r)))
print(json.dumps(res))

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
from collections import Counter
def f(inp):
    h,w=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in inp for x in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    sepR={r for r in range(h) if len(set(inp[r]))==1 and inp[r][0]!=bg}
    sepC={c for c in range(w) if len({inp[r][c] for r in range(h)})==1 and inp[0][c]!=bg}
    cells=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if inp[r][c]!=bg and r not in sepR and c not in sepC]
    rs=[r for r,c in cells]; cs=[c for r,c in cells]
    r0=min(rs); c0=min(cs)
    # pattern bbox limited within its own band; take contiguous band containing min cell
    def bandstart(seq, n):
        s=set(seq)
        for r in sorted(s):
            if r+n-1<=max(rs) or True: pass
        return r
    # just use pattern = rows r0..max(rs) restricted: but if sep splits bands, use band heights
    vr=max(rs)-r0+1
    pr=[inp[r][:] for r in range(r0,max(r0+vr, max(rs)+1))]
    pv=r1-r0+1
    P=[[inp[r][c] for c in range(c0,c0+pc)] for r in range(r0,r0+min(pv, max(rs)-r0+1))]
    O=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if i in sepR or j in sepC: O[i][j]=inp[i][0]
            else: O[i][j]=P[i-r0 % pv][j-c0 % pc]
    return O
